description: Fetch one specific PR Newswire release by its URL (source: prnewswire.com), as returned by prnewswire_latest_releases or prnewswire_search_releases. Re-fetches the live feed each call — a release that has scrolled off the current ~20-item window will not be found.

url.description: The release URL (from a prior prnewswire tool call).

name: prnewswire_get_release
